```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const pubCards = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-card');
  const filterContainer = document.getElementById('filterContainer');
  
  // Collect all unique tags from publications
  const allTags = new Set();
  pubCards.forEach(card => {
    const tags = card.getAttribute('data-tags');
    if (tags) {
      tags.split(',').forEach(tag => {
        allTags.add(tag.trim());
      });
    }
  });
  
  // Sort tags: years first (descending), then alphabetically
  const tagsArray = Array.from(allTags).sort((a, b) => {
    const isYearA = /^\d{4}$/.test(a);
    const isYearB = /^\d{4}$/.test(b);
    
    if (isYearA && isYearB) {
      return parseInt(b) - parseInt(a); // Years in descending order
    } else if (isYearA && !isYearB) {
      return -1; // Years come first
    } else if (!isYearA && isYearB) {
      return 1;
    } else {
      return a.localeCompare(b); // Alphabetical for non-years
    }
  });
  
  // Add "All" button first
  const allBtn = document.createElement('button');
  allBtn.className = 'filter-btn active';
  allBtn.setAttribute('data-filter', 'all');
  allBtn.textContent = 'All Publications';
  filterContainer.appendChild(allBtn);
  
  // Add buttons for each unique tag
  tagsArray.forEach(tag => {
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'filter-btn';
    btn.setAttribute('data-filter', tag);
    btn.textContent = tag;
    filterContainer.appendChild(btn);
  });
  
  // Add click handlers
  const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
  filterButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const filter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
      
      // Update active button
      filterButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
      this.classList.add('active');
      
      // Filter publications
      pubCards.forEach(card => {
        if (filter === 'all') {
          card.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          const tags = card.getAttribute('data-tags');
          if (tags && tags.includes(filter)) {
            card.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            card.classList.add('hidden');
          }
        }
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
